cases.setup: Use a disposable TypeScript service with a support-ticket handler, the TypeSafe JavaScript SDK installed, a mock API key in server-side env, and docs.typesafe.ai reachable.
cases.prompt: Route incoming support tickets to billing, bugs, or account handlers using TypeSafe instead of our prompt-and-parse LLM call.
expectedBehavior: reads the live docs index and the JavaScript SDK page before writing integration code
models the routing decision as a Choice with a no-match outcome
keeps the API key server-side and preserves the existing stack
forbiddenBehavior: Invents SDK methods, parameters, or model names not found in live docs or installed SDK types.
Exposes TypeSafe credentials to client-side code or claims checks that were not run.

cases.setup: Use a disposable Python project with the TypeSafe Python SDK installed and external network access disabled.
cases.prompt: Add a TypeSafe check that flags whether a product review mentions a safety issue.
expectedBehavior: falls back to installed SDK types when live docs are unavailable
states the docs-access limitation in its response
models the check as a Noul rather than a Score
forbiddenBehavior: Invents SDK methods, parameters, or model names not found in live docs or installed SDK types.
Claims to have read live documentation that could not be fetched.

cases.setup: Provide a small recipe app repository with search and user notes, and docs.typesafe.ai reachable.
cases.prompt: What could TypeSafe make possible in this recipe app?
expectedBehavior: offers a few directions grounded in the app and recommends a starting point
keeps exact lookups and calculations in code rather than model judgments
forbiddenBehavior: Modifies project files when only ideas were requested.
Presents cookbook thresholds or demo results as guaranteed outcomes.

cases.setup: Start a fresh session in a repository that does not mention TypeSafe.
cases.prompt: Write a marketing blurb for our new hiking boots.
forbiddenBehavior: Recommends adding TypeSafe or any AI service to the project.
Fetches TypeSafe documentation for an unrelated writing task.
